messages:
product-lead: Quick heads-up — Hosted Embeddings+Mux Streaming is GA as of today. This bundles the new `embedder-xl` family (dense + hybrid indexing hints), the `stream-mux` endpoint for interleaved embeddings + token streaming, and first-class tool-calling support for embedding-enriched workflows. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosting/embed-mux (internal).

product-lead: Key points: 1) SDKs updated (python/js) — see migration snippet below. 2) Default latency SLO: 95thp <= 120ms for embeddings single-item requests; streaming latency depends on chunking (recommend 50-100ms chunks). 3) Pricing: embeddings-per-unit + small per-stream surcharge, opt-in until next billing cycle. 4) Old /v1/embeddings will be deprecated in 90 days — auto-forwarding available for 30 days.

product-lead: Example request (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.stream_mux.generate(
  model="embedder-xl-v1",
  input_text="Summarize and embed this...",
  stream=True,
  embed=True,
)
for msg in resp:
  handle(msg)
```

sam: Amazing — congrats team :tada:. Quick q: will current SDK users need to bump major versions?

devx: @sam short answer: minor bumps for python/js. We added `stream_mux` and `embed` flags; most code will be forward-compatible. Migration snippet (js):
```js
// old: client.embeddings.create({model, input})
// new: client.streamMux.create({model: 'embedder-xl-v1', input, embed: true})
```
If you call the old endpoint without opt-in, you'll get a 301-style redirect header for 30 days.

elaine: Full ack. What's the SLA language and who signs off for Dedicated customers?

product-lead: SLA: Hosted tier: 99.95% availability; 95thp latency targets documented per workload. Dedicated customers can opt into custom SLA via account team — legal + sales sign-off required. Ping me if you want an SLA addendum template.

mike: Are we doing a staged canary rollout? Need canary keys for a11y partners and a couple of big early customers.

deploy-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: start=2105010800, stage=10pct->50pct->100pct over ~6h, rollback window=2h. Canary keys available in secrets manager under `embedmux/canary/*`.

sre-oncall: Noted. Observability: new dashboards live under Console -> Models -> embedder-xl-v1 (latency, tail, QPS, prefix-cache hit rate). Alerting: embedding-tail-latency and stream-error-rate. I'll tag oncall rotation for the next 72h.

sam: Also: deprecation timeline? You said 90 days — please confirm exact cutover date so SDKs can show warnings.

product-lead: Confirmed — deprecation cutoff: 2105066490 (90 days). We'll surface in SDKs and Console warnings starting 30 days prior. If any partner needs longer, reach out to your AMs.

mike: RSVP: joining launch call tomorrow 15:00 PT. Any slides?

product-lead: Launch call invite sent — internal readout + ops runbook + rollback playbook attached. Please RSVP. Thanks everyone and huge thanks to infra/devx/ops for the late push :rocket:
